assertionResults.fullName: 10.18b — blocked criteria, recorded as skipped and never passed ED-06 / SPK-02 — the authenticated route through the real ingress AC-14 [ED-06, SPK-02 question 4, Platform/SRE (ingress)] — a 15 s HEARTBEAT KEEPS AN IDLE STREAM OPEN across the ingress and any platform proxy, and the EFFECTIVE MAXIMUM STREAM LIFETIME is measured against the intended 60 s.
